entries.title: Psalms 44:1
segments:
PSALM XLIV. 
 
  The church commemorates past mercies, ver. 1-8.   Complains of present troubles, ver. 9-16.   Professes her integrity, ver. 17-22.   Prays for succour, ver. 23-26.   To the chief musician for the sons of Korah, Maschil.

entries.title: Psalms 44:4
segments: V. 4. My king-The whole people speak as one man, being united in one body.

entries.title: Psalms 44:11
segments: V. 11. Scattered-Those who were not slain are carried into captivity, and dispersed in several places.

entries.title: Psalms 44:16
segments: V. 16. Avenger-Who executeth both God's and his own vengeance upon me.

entries.title: Psalms 44:17
segments: V. 17. Yet-Although we cannot excuse ourselves from many other sins, yet through thy grace we have kept ourselves from apostacy and idolatry, notwithstanding all examples and provocations.

entries.title: Psalms 44:18
segments: V. 18. Turned-From thy worship to idols.

entries.title: Psalms 44:19
segments: V. 19. Broken us-By inflicting upon us one breach after another, thou hast at last brought us to this pass.  The place-A place extremely desolate, such as dragons love,
, and therefore full of horror, and danger.  Covered us-With deadly horrors and miseries.

entries.title: Psalms 44:22
segments: V. 22. Yea-Because we are constant in thy worship, which they abhor.

entries.title: Psalms 44:25
segments: V. 25. Our soul-Our persons.  Our belly-We are not only thrown down to the earth, but we lie there like dead carcases.
